basic_info.description: Spectacular Penthouse at the Infinity! Penthouse A boasts the highest ceilings and the largest terrace at The Infinity. This entertainer's home offers true indoor / outdoor resort living and entertaining and features floor to ceiling windows, designer hardwood floors, upgraded Caesarstone countertops, Poggenpohl cabinets, Bosch / Thermador appliances, custom closet treatments, pre-wired home audio, and custom window coverings.    Host your events and guests in the club room & movie theater, and work out in the professional-quality gym. Walk to the waterfront Embarcadero, Farmer's Market, Union Square and the Financial District. Easy access to the Bay Bridge, 280 and 101. Life is better at the top.
